_comment: Deployment facts for this project, read by morfdeploy. The four install steps live in one place for the whole parc; this file states only what is specific to this service.
description: Single source of truth about a machine's state
_comment_app_dir: Overridden by MORF_APP_DIR, one variable for every service. The old per-project spellings (MT_/MN_/MS_) are still honoured with a notice.
_comment_configs: Copied at install. Never overwritten by default: these hold settings edited by hand on the machine. Only this service's OWN config is listed here; the shared parc file (morfsystem.json) is NOT -- it has a single owner, morfTools `config.py shared`, and morfMonitor merely declares it a prerequisite (see requires_shared_config).
_comment_requires_shared_config: morfMonitor supervises the parc described by the shared /etc/morfsystem/morfsystem.json. That file is owned and placed by morfTools `config.py shared`, never by this install. Declaring it a prerequisite makes morfdeploy VERIFY it exists before registering the unit -- it never creates it. `morf install` runs `config.py shared merge` beforehand, so the prerequisite is already met; a bare service.py install stops with the command that places the file.
_comment_config_dir: La configuration vit sous /etc/morfsystem/<service> : un point d'entree UNIQUE dans /etc pour tout le parc, et non a cote du binaire dans /opt. Effacer /opt/<service> pour reinstaller proprement n'emporte donc pas les reglages.
